items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you listen to Cleopatra, Whose Afraid of Virginia Woolf or Spartacus or any one of them they’re just, they are masterpieces.

ctx.x: I remember in the early 50s Miles said in print that he was raving about Alex North his, Streetcar Named Desire score he said that was something everybody should hear.

Yeah, most people didn't really realize how great Alex North was, you listen to Cleopatra, Whose Afraid of Virginia Woolf or Spartacus or any one of them they’re just, they are masterpieces. And his orchestration is all like fine line drawing, he really knew his orchestra to.
He used Benny Carter on Streetcar didn’t he?
